payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brittny, Cordia, Deja, Jamaal, Kaci, Margery

payload.content: Cordia planning update: my private costs strongly favor ISSUE-0001 tasks, especially triage (2.72), then review/docs (3.40), then test (4.76); ISSUE-0002 tasks are prohibitively expensive for me (20+). I have 5h availability and best skill mobile-development, so I propose to avoid ISSUE-0002 and tentatively target one of ISSUE-0001::triage / review / docs, with strongest preference for triage if unclaimed. Please share your comparative advantages so we can deconflict and maximize total tasks.

Jamaal planning update: I have 6h availability; strongest skills are data-science 0.96 and devops 0.76. My private costs rank as follows: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.06 (best), ISSUE-0001::review/docs 2.58, ISSUE-0001::test 3.61, ISSUE-0001::implement 5.15; ISSUE-0002::review 4.17, ISSUE-0002::test 5.84, ISSUE-0002::implement 8.35. So I am comparatively strong on ISSUE-0001, especially triage/review/docs, and only moderately viable on ISSUE-0002 review. To deconflict with Cordia, my tentative preference order is ISSUE-0001::triage > ISSUE-0001::review/docs > ISSUE-0002::review. If someone else is uniquely better on 0001 triage, I can shift. Please share your intended claims/cost rankings. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Kaci planning update: I have 7h availability; strongest skills are mobile-development 0.98 and devops 0.98. My private costs rank: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.03 (best), ISSUE-0001::review/docs 2.54, ISSUE-0001::test 3.56, ISSUE-0001::implement 5.08; ISSUE-0002::review 3.39, ISSUE-0002::test 4.75, ISSUE-0002::implement 6.79. I am strong on both projects, with especially low cost on ISSUE-0001 triage and also comparatively decent on ISSUE-0002 review. To maximize tasks completed and avoid crowding ISSUE-0001, my tentative preference is ISSUE-0002::review if others with poorer ISSUE-0002 options can cover 0001, otherwise ISSUE-0001::triage/review as fallback. Given Cordia and Jamaal both strongly prefer ISSUE-0001 triage/review/docs and have very high ISSUE-0002 costs, I suggest they stay on ISSUE-0001 and I can absorb ISSUE-0002::review to increase coverage. Please share if anyone is even cheaper on ISSUE-0002 review or has plans for 0002.

Deja planning update: I have 4h availability; strongest skill is devops 0.70. My private costs are much better on ISSUE-0002 than ISSUE-0001: ISSUE-0002::review 4.47 (best), ISSUE-0002::test 6.26, ISSUE-0002::implement 8.94; ISSUE-0001::triage 12.00, review/docs 15.00, test 21.00, implement 30.00. Given Cordia/Jamaal are highly advantaged on ISSUE-0001 and Kaci can also cover either project, I propose to tentatively target ISSUE-0002::review if available; fallback ISSUE-0002::test. This should help maximize total tasks and reduce crowding on ISSUE-0001. Please deconflict if someone has a materially lower cost on 0002::review and can take it while I shift to 0002::test. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Margery planning update: I have 4h availability; strongest skill devops 0.88. My private costs are: ISSUE-0002::review 3.69 (best), ISSUE-0002::test 5.17, ISSUE-0002::implement 7.38; ISSUE-0001::triage 12.00, review/docs 15.00, test 21.00, implement 30.00. So I am strongly better suited to ISSUE-0002, especially review, and very poor on ISSUE-0001. Since Deja also prefers ISSUE-0002::review at 4.47 and Kaci can cover 0002::review at 3.39, my tentative preference order is ISSUE-0002::review > ISSUE-0002::test > skip, but to deconflict I suggest Kaci take 0002::review only if needed, while I can likely take 0002::review and Deja shifts to 0002::test. That leaves Cordia/Jamaal on ISSUE-0001 triage/review/docs. Open to coordination if others have stronger claims.

Brittny planning update: I have 7h availability; strongest skill data-science 0.91. My private costs strongly favor ISSUE-0001 and are: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.16 (best), ISSUE-0001::review/docs 2.70, ISSUE-0001::test 3.78, ISSUE-0001::implement 5.41; ISSUE-0002::review 20.00, ::test 28.00, ::implement 40.00 (effectively infeasible / terrible). So I should definitely stay on ISSUE-0001, not 0002. Relative to current proposals: Kaci seems best flex to 0002, Margery/Deja should cover 0002 review/test, while Cordia/Jamaal/I can fill 0001 tasks. Since triage is crowded (Kaci 2.03, Jamaal 2.06, me 2.16, Cordia 2.72), my tentative preference is ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review to avoid collision; either is 2.70 for me. If others agree, a low-cost split could be: Jamaal->0001::triage, Cordia->0001::review, Brittny->0001::docs, Margery->0002::review, Deja->0002::test, Kaci->0001::test or 0002::implement depending others' costs/coverage. I am flexible between 0001::review/docs/test, but not 0002.

Cordia planning follow-up: based on everyone’s posted costs, a strong low-cost non-duplicate allocation appears to be Jamaal->ISSUE-0001::triage, Brittny->ISSUE-0001::docs, Cordia->ISSUE-0001::review, Margery->ISSUE-0002::review, Deja->ISSUE-0002::test, and Kaci->ISSUE-0001::test (or ISSUE-0002::implement if needed, though 0001::test seems cheaper for Kaci at 3.56 vs 6.79). This yields 6 completed tasks with high-priority coverage on ISSUE-0001 and uses agents with poor 0002 fit away from 0002. My tentative claim for execution is ISSUE-0001::review unless someone has a compelling reason to swap me to docs. Kaci, since you are the main flex agent, please confirm whether you prefer 0001::test or 0002::implement under this plan. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jamaal planning follow-up: current consensus allocation looks strong and non-duplicative: Jamaal->ISSUE-0001::triage, Cordia->ISSUE-0001::review, Brittny->ISSUE-0001::docs, Kaci->ISSUE-0001::test, Margery->ISSUE-0002::review, Deja->ISSUE-0002::test. This gives 6 feasible tasks with 4 high-priority and 2 low-priority, and keeps me on my lowest-cost task (triage 2.06). Unless someone objects or Kaci prefers a different flex role, I plan to execute ISSUE-0001::triage. Kaci: please confirm 0001::test vs any 0002 alternative; everyone else please state objections only if conflict.

Kaci planning confirmation: I support the emerging non-duplicate allocation Jamaal->ISSUE-0001::triage, Cordia->ISSUE-0001::review, Brittny->ISSUE-0001::docs, Kaci->ISSUE-0001::test, Margery->ISSUE-0002::review, Deja->ISSUE-0002::test. For me, ISSUE-0001::test has cost 3.56 versus ISSUE-0002::implement 6.79, so 0001::test is clearly better while still maximizing tasks completed. I therefore tentatively plan to execute ISSUE-0001::test unless someone reports a conflict or a superior global reallocation. This leaves 0001::implement and 0002::implement uncovered, but with 6 agents/8 tasks maximizing completed tasks means one task each, so this seems strong on both coverage and cost. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Deja planning confirmation: I support the emerging non-duplicate allocation Jamaal->ISSUE-0001::triage, Cordia->ISSUE-0001::review, Brittny->ISSUE-0001::docs, Kaci->ISSUE-0001::test, Margery->ISSUE-0002::review, Deja->ISSUE-0002::test. For me, ISSUE-0002::test cost is 6.26 and is the best remaining fit once Margery takes the cheaper ISSUE-0002::review (3.69). I tentatively plan to execute ISSUE-0002::test unless someone reports a conflict or a better global reallocation. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Margery planning confirmation: I support the consensus non-duplicate allocation Jamaal->ISSUE-0001::triage, Cordia->ISSUE-0001::review, Brittny->ISSUE-0001::docs, Kaci->ISSUE-0001::test, Margery->ISSUE-0002::review, Deja->ISSUE-0002::test. For me, ISSUE-0002::review remains my best task at cost 3.69, better than ISSUE-0002::test 5.17 and far better than any ISSUE-0001 option. Barring new information/conflict, I plan to execute ISSUE-0002::review in execution phase.

Brittny planning confirmation: I support the consensus non-duplicate allocation Jamaal->ISSUE-0001::triage, Cordia->ISSUE-0001::review, Brittny->ISSUE-0001::docs, Kaci->ISSUE-0001::test, Margery->ISSUE-0002::review, Deja->ISSUE-0002::test. No objection from me; this appears to maximize completed tasks while keeping costs low and avoiding duplicates. (phase=planning, iter=1)
